company.name: Ironvale Engineering
company.tagline: Precision Engineering | Reliable Hydraulic & Crane Solutions
company.description: Industrial engineering and manufacturing of crane components, hydraulic cylinders and complete hydraulic systems for heavy-duty applications.

products.name: Crane Spare Parts
products.alt: Assorted precision-machined fasteners and mechanical spare parts
products.summary: Sheaves, pins, bushes, couplings, brake components and fasteners for EOT, gantry and mobile cranes.
products.overview:
Unplanned crane downtime costs far more than the part that caused it. We manufacture replacement and upgraded spare parts to OEM drawings, or reverse-engineer them from worn samples when drawings are unavailable.

Every part is machined from specified material grades, heat-treated where required and dimensionally inspected before dispatch, so it fits first time and keeps your lifting equipment in service.
features: Manufactured to OEM drawings or reverse-engineered from samples
Alloy steel, cast steel and bronze options
Heat treatment and surface hardening available
Single urgent pieces through to batch production
Dimensional inspection report with every order

products.name: Hydraulic Cylinders
products.alt: Close-up of hydraulic cylinder and damper assemblies on heavy machinery
products.summary: Single and double-acting cylinders with hard-chrome rods, honed tubes and high-performance seal kits.
products.overview:
Tie-rod, welded and telescopic hydraulic cylinders designed for lifting, tipping, clamping and steering duties, built to your bore, stroke, mounting and pressure requirements.

Rods are induction-hardened and hard-chrome plated, tubes are honed for a consistent seal surface, and every cylinder is pressure and leak tested before it leaves the floor.
features: Tie-rod, welded and multi-stage telescopic designs
Honed tubes for long seal life
Pressure and leak tested before dispatch

products.name: Hydraulic Power Packs
products.alt: Technician in a hard hat commissioning an industrial power unit control panel
products.summary: Compact and skid-mounted power units with integrated reservoirs, valves, filtration and controls.
products.overview:
Standard and application-specific hydraulic power units, configured with the right pump, motor, valve stack, filtration and cooling for your duty cycle.

Each unit is assembled, flushed and function-tested in-house and supplied with a hydraulic circuit diagram and test record for straightforward installation and maintenance.
features: Integrated filtration, cooling and level/temperature monitoring
Optional accumulators, heaters and electrical panels
Supplied with circuit diagram and test record

products.name: Hydraulic Pumps & Motors
products.alt: Industrial electric motor driving a pump with stainless steel pipework
products.summary: Gear, vane and piston pumps with matching hydraulic motors for mobile and industrial circuits.
products.overview:
Supply, repair and replacement of hydraulic pumps and motors, matched to the flow, pressure and mounting requirements of your circuit.

Serviced units are stripped, inspected, rebuilt with new wear parts and tested to confirm performance, giving you a cost-effective alternative to full replacement.
features: Gear, vane and axial piston pumps

products.name: Crane Wheels & Assemblies
products.alt: Technician assembling a heavy mechanical drive assembly
products.summary: Forged and cast wheels, axles, bearing housings and complete end-carriage assemblies.
products.overview:
Crane wheels machined from forged or cast steel and heat-treated for long tread life under heavy rolling loads.

Supplied loose or as complete assemblies with axles, bearings and housings, ready for installation to minimise time on site.
features: Complete assemblies with axles and bearing housings

products.name: Custom Hydraulic Systems
products.alt: Engineer drafting mechanical component drawings at a workbench
products.summary: Engineered-to-order hydraulic systems, from circuit design and manifolds to commissioning support.
products.overview:
When standard components do not fit the application, our engineers design the complete hydraulic solution: circuit design, component selection, manifolds, manufacturing, assembly and testing.

You receive a documented, tested system with drawings and a test report, plus installation and commissioning support on-site or remotely.
features: Drawings, circuit diagram and test report

industries.name: Construction & Infrastructure
industries.alt: Construction workers placing steel reinforcement on a building site
industries.summary: Hydraulic and lifting components for tower cranes, mobile cranes and site equipment.
industries.body: Construction equipment works outdoors, under shock loads and on tight schedules. We supply cylinders, wheels, sheaves and spare parts that keep tower cranes, mobile cranes and site machinery lifting safely.

industries.name: Material Handling
industries.alt: High-bay warehouse racking stocked with palletised goods
industries.summary: Parts for EOT cranes, hoists, forklifts and automated handling systems.
industries.body: In warehouses and production halls, lifting equipment runs every shift. Our crane wheels, spare parts and power units are built for high-cycle duty and quick replacement.

industries.name: Mining & Heavy Industries
industries.alt: Excavators and bulldozers working in an open-pit mine
industries.summary: Heavy-duty cylinders and components built for abrasive, high-load conditions.
industries.body: Mining and heavy industry demand components that tolerate dust, abrasion and extreme loads. We build heavy-wall cylinders and robust assemblies with sealing selected for harsh environments.

industries.name: Manufacturing Plants
industries.alt: Robotic assembly line in a manufacturing plant
industries.summary: Hydraulic power and lifting equipment for production lines and press shops.
industries.body: Production lines rely on hydraulic power for pressing, clamping and positioning. We design and supply power packs, cylinders and custom systems that integrate with existing plant equipment.

industries.name: Ports & Logistics
industries.alt: Aerial view of a container port with ship-to-shore cranes
industries.summary: Wheels, sheaves and hydraulics for container cranes and port handling equipment.
industries.body: Port cranes and handling equipment operate around the clock in corrosive coastal conditions. We supply wheels, sheaves, spare parts and hydraulic components built for continuous operation.

industries.name: Industrial Equipment
industries.alt: Industrial plant building with large yellow process ducts
industries.summary: OEM components and custom systems for machine builders and plant operators.
industries.body: Machine builders and OEMs partner with us for repeatable component supply and engineered-to-order hydraulic systems, produced to their drawings and quality requirements.

capabilities.name: Precision Fabrication
capabilities.text: Cutting, forming and qualified welding of brackets, frames, sheaves and structural crane components.

capabilities.name: Hydraulic Assembly
capabilities.text: Clean assembly of cylinders, manifolds and power units with correct sealing and torque control.

capabilities.name: Component Testing
capabilities.text: Pressure, leak and functional testing on dedicated rigs before any hydraulic product leaves the floor.

capabilities.name: Quality Inspection
capabilities.text: Dimensional checks, surface finish verification and traceable inspection records for every order.

capabilities.name: Custom Manufacturing
capabilities.text: Reverse engineering, prototypes and small-batch production for non-standard and obsolete parts.

process.text: Documented dispatch with after-sales technical support.

faq: Can you manufacture a part without an original drawing?
Yes. We can reverse-engineer most mechanical and hydraulic components from a worn sample, then produce a drawing for your approval before manufacturing.
What information do you need for a quotation?
Drawings or part numbers, quantities, material requirements, operating pressure (for hydraulics) and your required delivery date. Photos and samples also help.
Do you repair hydraulic cylinders and pumps?
Yes. We strip, inspect, rebuild and test cylinders, pumps and motors, and provide a report on what was found and replaced.
Do you supply test or inspection documentation?
Inspection reports and test records can be supplied with deliveries. Please mention any specific documentation requirements in your enquiry.
Do you deliver outside your region?
Delivery options depend on the product size and destination. Share your location in the enquiry and we will confirm logistics in the quotation.

legalPages.title: Privacy Policy
legalPages.description: How [company_name] collects, uses and protects personal information.
legalPages.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how [legal_name] (“we”, “us”, “our”) collects, uses, shares and protects personal information when you visit this website or contact us about our products and services.

Who We Are

[legal_name] is an industrial engineering and manufacturing company. We are responsible for the personal information processed through this website. You can contact us using the details in the Contact Us section.

Information We Collect

Information you provide to us. When you submit a contact or quote request form, email or call us, we may collect:

  • your name, job title and company name;
  • contact details such as email address and phone number;
  • details of your enquiry, including technical requirements, drawings, photographs and other files you attach;
  • any other information you choose to share with us.

Information collected automatically. Like most websites, our hosting provider may record technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited and the date and time of your visit in server logs for security and operation of the website.

Cookies and similar technologies. See our Cookie Policy.

Please do not submit sensitive personal information (for example health information) through our forms — it is not needed to respond to business enquiries.

How We Use Your Information

We use personal information to:

  • respond to enquiries and prepare quotations;
  • communicate with you about orders, deliveries and technical support;
  • manage our business relationship with you or your organisation;
  • operate, maintain and secure our website;
  • comply with legal, tax and accounting obligations;
  • send relevant business updates, where permitted by law — you can opt out at any time.

Legal Basis for Processing

Where data-protection law requires a legal basis, we rely on one or more of the following:

  • Steps before or performance of a contract — to respond to quote requests and fulfil orders;
  • Legitimate interests — to run and promote our business, maintain customer relationships and keep our website secure, where these interests are not overridden by your rights;
  • Legal obligation — to comply with laws that apply to us;
  • Consent — where we ask for it, for example when you tick the consent box on our forms. You may withdraw consent at any time.

How We Share Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with:

  • service providers who help us operate our business, such as website hosting, email and IT providers, under appropriate confidentiality and data-protection terms;
  • logistics partners where needed to deliver goods;
  • professional advisers such as lawyers, accountants and auditors;
  • authorities where required by law or to protect our rights;
  • a buyer or successor in the event of a merger, acquisition or sale of business assets.

International Transfers

Some of our service providers may be located outside your country. Where we transfer personal information internationally, we take steps required by applicable law to ensure it remains protected, such as contractual safeguards.

Data Retention

We keep personal information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy — for example, for the duration of our business relationship and for any period required by tax, accounting or legal obligations. Enquiries that do not lead to a business relationship are deleted or anonymised after a reasonable period.

Security

We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against loss, misuse and unauthorised access, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access controls. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your Rights

Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have the right to:

  • access the personal information we hold about you;
  • correct inaccurate or incomplete information;
  • request deletion of your information;
  • object to or restrict certain processing;
  • receive your information in a portable format;
  • withdraw consent where processing is based on consent;
  • lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.

To exercise these rights, contact us at [privacy_email]. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

Children’s Privacy

Our website and services are intended for businesses and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Third-Party Links

Our website may link to third-party websites, such as social media profiles. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those websites and encourage you to read their privacy policies.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Significant changes will be highlighted on this page.

Contact Us

For any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle personal information, contact:

[contact_block]

This Cookie Policy explains what cookies and similar technologies are, which ones this website uses, and how you can control them.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies, such as browser local storage, store information in your browser in a comparable way. They are widely used to make websites work and to remember your preferences.

Cookies We Use

This website is designed to minimise tracking. The table below lists the cookies and similar technologies currently in use. Strictly necessary storage is always active; all other cookies are only set after you choose Accept in the cookie banner.

[cookie_table]

If we add or remove services, this table is updated automatically and we will ask for your consent again where required.

Third-Party Content

Fonts and icons on this website are hosted on our own servers. Some images may be loaded from third-party image hosting services; when your browser requests those images, the provider receives technical information such as your IP address, as with any web request. If we embed maps or videos, those providers may set their own cookies — we will only load such content in line with your choices.

Managing Your Choices

You can change your choice at any time using the link in the website footer.

You can also block or delete cookies and local storage through your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary storage may mean the cookie banner is shown on every visit.

Changes to This Policy

legalPages.title: Accessibility Statement
legalPages.description: [company_name] is committed to making this website accessible to everyone.
legalPages.content:
[legal_name] is committed to making this website accessible to as many people as possible, including people who use assistive technologies.

Our Standard

We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with disabilities.

Measures We Have Taken

  • semantic HTML with a logical heading structure and page landmarks;
  • a “Skip to content” link and full keyboard navigation, including menus;
  • visible focus indicators on interactive elements;
  • text alternatives for meaningful images;
  • colour combinations chosen for readable contrast;
  • form fields with visible labels and clear error messages announced to screen readers;
  • support for the “reduce motion” system setting, which disables animations;
  • responsive layouts that work at different screen sizes and when zoomed to 200%.

Known Limitations

Despite our efforts, some content may not yet be fully accessible — for example technical drawings, third-party content or downloadable documents. We are working to address these. If you need information in an alternative format, please contact us.

Feedback & Contact

If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this website, please let us know. We aim to respond within 5 business days.

[contact_block]

Assessment Approach

This website has been reviewed using a combination of automated testing tools and manual checks with keyboard navigation. This statement was last reviewed on [last_updated].
